_doc: Registry for the Browser Verification Protocol (see CLAUDE.md) and the verify_reminder.py hook. Add one entry per browser-based project under 'projects'; the hook stays silent while this list is empty. Fields: name = short slug (used for the reminder cooldown lockfile), dir_prefix = path substring that identifies the project's files, verify_md = path to the project's VERIFY.md, port = dev-server port to check.
